description: This file provides helper functions for testing tools related to memory management within the openclaw project, including functions to create memory search/get tools, configure default settings, and validate unavailability details.

methods.name: export function asOpenClawConfig(config: Partial<OpenClawConfig>): OpenClawConfig { asOpenClawConfig
methods.description: Casts a partial OpenClawConfig object to a complete OpenClawConfig.

methods.name: export function createDefaultMemoryToolConfig(): OpenClawConfig { createDefaultMemoryToolConfig
methods.description: Creates a default OpenClawConfig with a main agent.

methods.name: export function createMemorySearchToolOrThrow(params?: { createMemorySearchToolOrThrow
methods.description: Creates a memory search tool with optional configuration and agent session key, throws error if tool is missing.

methods.name: export function createMemoryGetToolOrThrow( createMemoryGetToolOrThrow
methods.description: Creates a memory get tool with default or specified configuration, throws error if tool is missing.

methods.name: export function createAutoCitationsMemorySearchTool(agentSessionKey: string) { createAutoCitationsMemorySearchTool
methods.description: Creates a memory search tool configured for auto citations with a given agent session key.

methods.name: export function expectUnavailableMemorySearchDetails( expectUnavailableMemorySearchDetails
methods.description: Validates that the given details object indicates an unavailable memory search result, matching expected error, warning, and action messages.
